name: crypto-scanner
description: Chart Scanner for crypto perpetuals. Scans the top perps of an exchange by 24h volume (or given symbols) for setups: a breakout of the session's opening range (crypto trades 24/7, so the session start is the user's, 00:00 UTC by default), RSI oversold/overbought. Use when the user says "scan the market", "what's moving", "find setups", "any breakouts", "what should I look at today".
